svg.title: 华中科技大学 Huazhong University of Science and Technology
svg.metadata: Official source artwork: https://www.hust.edu.cn/images/logo20240628.png (complete university wordmark) and https://gs.hust.edu.cn/img/logo.png (color emblem only). Original emblem colors are preserved. The university white wordmark is rendered in official HUST blue #004B84.
